thread:
omar: Heads-up from test run: Go sample returns different error fields than Python/TS, causing onboarding flakiness.
kevin: Example payloads?
rachel: Go: `{"error":{"code":"rate_limited","msg":"slow down"}}`
sylvia: Py: `{"error":{"type":"RateLimitError","message":"quota hit","retry_after":10}}`
andy: So key names differ (msg vs message), and Go lacks retry_after. That breaks sampleapp's automated guidance.
ci-bot: sampleapp-onboard-smoke: failed for go-sample (error shape mismatch).
kevin: Proposal: canonical error shape = error.type (PascalCase), error.code (snake_case stable id), error.message (string), error.retry_after (int|null), error.retry_hint (enum). Also include http_status as top-level int.
omar: Can we require both retry_after and retry_hint? Some clients only parse one.
sylvia: Yes keep both: retry_after if server sends Retry-After; retry_hint for client behavior.
kevin: Action items: rachel to open a failing PR with Go output; omar to add CI contract test that hits simulate-error endpoints for each SDK; sylvia to draft canonical schema + mapping table for SDKs. I'll own the RFC to add to SDK parity checklist.
